title: Jamaican Pastry Pie
description: A sweet and flaky pastry pie filled with a delicious Jamaican-inspired filling. Perfect as a dessert or snack.
instructions: Roll out the pastry sheet to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer the pastry to a 9-inch pie dish.
In a bowl, mix together the chopped nuts, Jamaican spice blend, and granulated sugar.
Pour the nut mixture into the pastry-lined pie dish.
Drizzle the melted oil over the nut mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with additional chopped nuts if desired.
